final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remaining FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS benchmark FROM per_order), above_first AS (SELECT p.avg_remaining, f.benchmark AS first_mean FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark f WHERE p.avg_remaining > f.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS benchmark FROM above_first), above_second AS (SELECT a.avg_remaining, a.first_mean, s.benchmark AS second_mean FROM above_first a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark s WHERE a.avg_remaining > s.benchmark) SELECT AVG(avg_remaining), AVG(avg_remaining - first_mean), AVG(avg_remaining - second_mean) FROM above_second
